St Theresa ss is private registered secondary school located in Wakiso district 11 kms along Mityana Fort portal road. It is a mixed secondary school for O and A Level education since 2014.

The new curriculum includes three science subjects are compulsory to all from S1 to S4: Biology, physics and chemistry, however at advanced studies they remain optional. We do offer sciences at both levels and students do pass and enroll for science-based programs at colleges and universities.

A] To promote the teaching of science in the curriculum. B] To equip learners with the necessary skills in practical subjects. C] To provide learners with facilities to do experiments independently. D] To support the limited cash inflows for school and provide teaching aids promptly.

The school has two labs used during teaching and learning. Our students and teachers find it hard during the learning process because they share apparatus and some miss the opportunity of hands-on. If given any physical support in terms of materials and reagents science performance and skills will be promoted in the school. The current status of our science labs has basic apparatus and reagents which limits the frequency of practical sessions.

TGUP's Science Lab in a Box (SLaB) is available at no charge to schools that are qualified to use it appropriately.
